Prime Minister Narendra Modi is visiting Bihar on November 21 to inaugurate Nitish Setu, a 9.76-km-long, six-lane bridge across the Ganga built at a cost of ₹5,500 crore. Connecting Kacchi Dargah in Patna with Bidupur in Vaishali, the bridge is expected to improve connectivity between north and south Bihar, ease travel and boost regional transport.
